main: Raw VIIRS Deep Blue L2 NetCDF was downloaded with Earthdata Bearer token.
Dust-support pixels require Aerosol_Type_Land_Ocean == 0, QA flag >= 2, and AOT550 >= 0.8.
Mask cells are rasterized from geolocated L2 pixels within the Hexi Corridor AOI.
supporting: D3 daily aggregate is parsed as low-resolution support only.
This replaces the previous authentication-blocked raw-data status.
conflicting: This is a raw aerosol/dust support mask, not Dust-Mamba or Element84 semantic segmentation inference.
Cloud/smoke/fire confounder model checks are still not executed on the raw VIIRS swath.
precursor: Wind/humidity and historical corridor evidence remain separate evidence-chain inputs.

provenance.model_name: VIIRS Deep Blue raw science-value threshold adapter
limitations: Threshold adapter, not learned dust segmentation.
AOT and aerosol type support dust interpretation but do not by themselves prove dust storm occurrence.
Area is estimated from display grid cells, not native swath pixel geodesic footprints.

display_policy: Display as real raw VIIRS Deep Blue science-value dust-support mask. Do not label as Dust-Mamba, Element84, or MODIS 3D-CNN model inference.
